scientific_review: Internal review checked chemistry, compartment-specific biosynthesis, conjugation and catabolism, NPR-family nuance and active NPR1 dimer, SAR and NHP, hormone context dependence, numerical examples and answer explanations; corrected ABA–ethylene treatment and added supporting primary sources.
editorial_review: Separate internal pass checked genuine narrative depth, reader architecture, question mapping, explanatory answers, diagrams, zoom targets, revision and source links. Some repeated caveats and simple distractors remain.
deductions: One point each for limited independent scientific verification, repeated explanatory caveats, no rendered illustration test, lack of external assessment calibration and no browser/assistive technology runtime test. Internal self-assessment.
